description:
Find SNP-genotyped lines in CropSNPdb by name or accession (e.g. 'Cascadia' (pea), 'CDC Asterix' (lentil)).
Returns line name, accession(s), country, pedigree, status, breeding organisation and donor. dataset: 'Pisum sativum Cameor v2 PSPPC' (default, alias 'pea'; 456 pea lines, GBS, 270K SNPs), 'Pisum sativum Cameor v2 AMS' ('pea_ams'; 240 lines, 641K SNPs), 'Lens culinaris CDC Redberry v2' ('lentil'; 324-line lentil diversity panel, exome capture, 460K SNPs), 'Cicer arietinum CDC Frontier v1' ('chickpea'; 279 wild and cultivated Cicer, WGS, 2.0M SNPs). Pea positions are Cameor v2 (not Ensembl Cameor v1a), chickpea CDC Frontier v1 (not v3).
name: snp_lines
